prayerExcerpt.en-US: You did not allow him to be daunted by threats or broken by suffering.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Não deixastes o papa e mártir São Martinho sucumbir às ameaças e ser vencido pelos tormentos.

meta.face: A man of about sixty-five, EMACIATED by prison and exile, with a LONG, NARROW, rectangular face and a tall forehead — a strong, straight Roman nose, large, dark, sorrowful eyes set deep in shadowed sockets under straight, thin grey brows, deeply HOLLOW cheeks beneath sharp, prominent cheekbones, a long, firm mouth; thin, straight, iron-GREY hair cut short and receding at the temples (no curls); a thin, iron-grey beard, close-trimmed and squared at the chin, showing the hollows of the cheeks (NOT full or bushy, not dark brown); a patient, steadfast gaze slightly downward.
meta.basis: No likeness survives; the bronze statue in Santa Maria della Consolazione at Todi, his birthplace (Wikipedia lead image), gives him a full beard. The card keeps a full, squared beard and a face thinned by his arrest, trial and exile in the Crimea, where he died in 655.
